windows: MSVC /O2 /GL /LTCG; logical processor 14; no frequency lock performed or verified; seven interleaved rounds, 524288 operations/round; median nanoseconds per arithmetic input. Not a full Reanimation update benchmark.
validation: Integer forward age/period quotient and remainder match; period boundaries and 0/1/2/127-frame crossings checked outside timing.
normal_scope: Actual game target >=100 and logic delta <=10ms. 60/30/15 Hz inputs are hypothetical arithmetic stress, not a claim about current simulation steps.
android: armv9-a+nosve+nosve2 -O3 binary compiled; disassembly confirms UDIV+MSUB for divide/remainder and genuine repeated SUB/CMP for while. Device disconnected; no ARM timing measured.
limitations: Independent array kernel; excludes cycle wrapping, nonloop endpoints, reverse playback, root motion and rendering. Do not substitute these figures for whole-game or previous full reanim microbenchmarks.
x86_disassembly: Measured executable checked: one DIV per input produces both quotient (RAX) and remainder (RDX). Loop unrolling processes two distinct inputs with two DIVs; this is not separate division and modulo for one input.
